items.textToSpeech: For adults aged 18+, excluding those pregnant or lactating, the Tolerable Upper Intake Level for copper is 5 milligrams per day. The upper level is not applicable during pregnancy or lactation because of inadequate data relating to this critical life stage.

The Tolerable Upper Intake Level is the maximum level of total chronic intake of a nutrient from all sources judged to be unlikely to pose a risk of adverse health effects in humans. For the European Union, Dietary Reference Values are published by the European Food Safety Authority Panel on Dietetic Products, Nutrition and Allergies. Is there anything else I can help you with?
